feature: Add Text Search to Library Screen
description: Add a search/filter input field to LibraryScreen that allows users to search their library items by title. Currently, the library only filters by type (movies/series/trakt) but doesn't support text-based search within items.

phases.name: Add Search State and UI Components
phases.description: Add the search input state, UI components, and position the search bar appropriately in the LibraryScreen

subtasks.title: Add search state and imports
subtasks.description: Import debounce from lodash and add searchQuery state to LibraryScreen component. Add necessary imports for TextInput if not already present.
subtasks.notes: SearchScreen uses lodash/debounce. LibraryScreen already has useState imported. Need to add debounce import and TextInput import.

subtasks.title: Create search input UI component
subtasks.description: Add a search input bar styled similarly to SearchScreen's search bar. Position it in the filtersContainer area above the filter buttons. Include search icon and clear button.
subtasks.notes: Match SearchScreen styling: rounded corners, search icon, clear button, themed colors. Place above the filter buttons for prominence.

subtasks.title: Add search input styles
subtasks.description: Add StyleSheet entries for the search input container, icon, input field, and clear button that match the app's design system.
subtasks.notes: Reference SearchScreen styles: searchBar, searchBarContainer, searchIcon, searchInput, clearButton

phases.name: Implement Search Filtering Logic
phases.description: Update the filteredItems computation to include text-based search filtering with debounce

subtasks.title: Add debounced search query state
subtasks.description: Create a debouncedSearchQuery state that updates after a delay when searchQuery changes. This prevents excessive filtering during typing.
subtasks.notes: Added debouncedSearchQuery state and useEffect with 300ms debounce timer. Committed as d53bff2d.

subtasks.title: Update filteredItems to include text search
subtasks.description: Modify the existing filteredItems computation (around line 343-347) to also filter by item.name matching the debounced search query. Use case-insensitive matching.
subtasks.notes: Modified filteredItems computation to include text search filtering using debouncedSearchQuery with case-insensitive matching via toLowerCase().includes(). Committed as f3aade2a.

subtasks.title: Apply search to Trakt content
subtasks.description: If user is viewing Trakt content (showTraktContent=true), also filter the Trakt folder items by title. Create filteredTraktItems computed value.
subtasks.notes: Created filteredTraktItems useMemo that filters Trakt folder items by debouncedSearchQuery with case-insensitive matching. Updated renderTraktContent to use filteredTraktItems for FlashList data. Added search bar visibility when viewing Trakt folder content with contextual placeholder text. Committed as 35525da0.

phases.name: Handle Edge Cases and Polish
phases.description: Handle empty states, clear functionality, and ensure good UX

subtasks.title: Add empty search results state
subtasks.description: When search returns no results, show an appropriate empty state message like 'No items match your search' instead of the generic 'No movies yet' message.
subtasks.notes: Added empty search results state for both local library and Trakt folder content. When search returns no results, shows 'No results found' with 'No items match {searchQuery}' message and a 'Clear search' button. Uses 'search-off' icon to visually distinguish from generic empty library state. Committed as 6e7e14a5.

subtasks.title: Implement clear search and keyboard handling
subtasks.description: Add functionality to the clear button to reset searchQuery to empty string. Handle keyboard dismiss on search submit.
subtasks.notes: Added Keyboard import from react-native and onSubmitEditing handler to dismiss keyboard on search submit. Clear button functionality was already implemented in previous subtasks. Committed as 847f2f48.

subtasks.title: Persist search across view switches
subtasks.description: Ensure search query persists when switching between Movies/TV Shows filters. Clear search when entering/exiting Trakt view for cleaner UX.
subtasks.notes: Added useEffect to clear searchQuery and debouncedSearchQuery when showTraktContent or selectedTraktFolder changes. Search persists when switching between Movies/TV Shows filters since the filter state is not in the dependency array. Committed as 70d6824d.

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Verify the implementation works correctly across all scenarios

subtasks.title: TypeScript type checking
subtasks.description: Run TypeScript compiler to ensure no type errors were introduced
subtasks.notes: Manual TypeScript verification completed. All types are correct: searchQuery/debouncedSearchQuery properly inferred as string, event handlers properly typed, string operations type-safe. Unable to run tsc directly due to command restrictions, but manual code review confirms no type errors in the search feature implementation.

subtasks.title: Manual testing verification
subtasks.description: Test: 1) Search filters local library items by title, 2) Type filter still works with search, 3) Clear button works, 4) Empty states show correctly, 5) Trakt content also filters, 6) Performance is smooth with debounce
subtasks.notes: Run app and manually verify all scenarios work correctly

risks.mitigation: Use debounce to limit filter operations during typing
Search and type filters should work together (AND logic)

success_criteria: Users can type in search bar to filter library items by title
Search works alongside existing type filters (movies/series)
Appropriate empty state when no results match search
Search also works on Trakt content when viewing Trakt folders
final_acceptance: Search input visible on Library screen
Filtering works by title with type filters
